$comment: Config for `npm run verify` (scripts/verify.mjs, scripts/verify-receipt.mjs). Only the keys the verify runner reads: the verify command name as CLAUDE.md quotes it, and the step list. command `pnpm`/`npm`/`npx` gets .cmd on Windows; `node` is the running Node binary. `journeys: true` marks the steps CI reruns on every PR/MR (build + the suites that drive the running app). `regenerates: true` marks a step that rewrites tracked output (a committed dist/): the tree is re-baselined after it, so the receipt binds to the tree a person commits.

steps.label: build (tsc, bundles, hook core, skills manifest, dashboard, smoke-test; regenerates the tracked dist/)
verify:release (lint, typecheck, version coherence, generated mirror, surface parity, doc claims, audits)
packaged artifact smoke (npm pack, install, run the CLI and doctor)
packaged dashboard e2e (Playwright Chromium against the real serve)
